name: youtube-music
description: Play and curate YouTube Music: throwaway session queues, a validated focus pool, and macOS Background Sounds control.

interface.shortDescription: Play YouTube Music and compose focus soundscapes
interface.longDescription: Play and curate the listening surface over the shared YouTube library. Builds throwaway session queues that cost zero API quota, curates a validated focus pool through an audition-then-promote funnel, and controls the macOS Background Sounds layer (rain and friends) so a work-session soundscape can be set in one step. Uses the ytx CLI for library writes.
defaultPrompt: Put on focus music for a work session
Build me a throwaway queue from my focus pool
Turn the rain background sound down
